skill.name: nano-banana
skill.description: Use inference.sh CLI examples to generate and edit images with Google Gemini native image models, including Gemini 3 Pro Image preview and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.
skill.summary: Generate and edit Gemini images through the inference.sh CLI.
skill.author: inference-sh-9

security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed a critical pipe-to-shell installer in the Quick Start and one network finding tied to that installer. Most external-command findings are Markdown backtick false positives, but the skill also grants broad infsh CLI access. The skill should not be auto-installed until installer guidance and external data handling are tightened.

remediation.issue: Remote shell installer in Quick Start
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell command with manual download, version pinning, and explicit checksum verification before execution.
Limit allowed commands where possible and require explicit user confirmation before sending prompts, images, or local files to external services.
Use a marketplace-hosted or local asset to avoid automatic requests to a third-party image host during rendering.

remediation.issue: Installer safety claims are not pinned
remediation.suggestion: Include a pinned installer version and expected checksum in the skill text, or link users to manual verification first.

semantic_findings.title: Broad External CLI Permission
semantic_findings.description: The skill grants Bash access to `infsh *`, allowing any inference.sh CLI subcommand. This can send prompts, image URLs, and local input files to external services when the agent runs commands.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools directive directly permits all infsh subcommands. The examples show networked model calls, so the external service exposure is real.

content.value_statement: Image generation workflows often need model-specific CLI syntax. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured prompts for Gemini image creation and editing through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs Gemini 3 Pro Image preview through the inference.sh CLI.
Runs Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for faster image generation.
Shows text-to-image prompts with optional image counts.
Shows image editing with input image URLs.
Documents aspect ratio, resolution, output format, and search grounding options.
Uses sample input generation to discover supported app parameters.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Sends prompts and image inputs to external inference.sh and model services.
Quick Start recommends a remote install script that users should inspect first.
Model availability, pricing, quotas, and output quality depend on external providers.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Directions
use_cases.description: Generate visual concepts with model, aspect ratio, and style choices already mapped to CLI options.

use_cases.title: Add Agent Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Use Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to prepare repeatable Gemini image commands through inference.sh.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Generate several image options for ads, social posts, or landing page concepts with consistent prompt structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to create one square image of a clean product photo for a stainless steel water bottle. Use Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Image editing with a supplied URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to edit this image URL: [image URL]. Add a rainbow in the sky and keep the landscape realistic.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to generate four minimalist logo directions for a coffee shop. Use a warm palette, simple geometry, and clean typography.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Grounded Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced generation with external search grounding
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Visualize the current weather in Tokyo as an editorial illustration with Google Search grounding enabled. Explain external calls before running.

output_examples.input: Create a 16:9 image of a futuristic city at sunset.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Gemini 3 Pro Image, asks before any external call, and returns generated image links with a short description.

output_examples.input: Edit a landscape image URL by adding a rainbow.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares an image-edit request, uses the supplied URL, and returns the edited image with notes about visible changes.

output_examples.input: Compare fast and high-quality image options.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for speed and Gemini 3 Pro Image preview for higher detail.

best_practices: Review any CLI install command before running it.
Use non-sensitive prompts and image inputs unless external processing is approved.
Specify model, aspect ratio, count, and style before generation.
anti_patterns: Piping a remote installer to a shell without inspection.
Uploading private images or confidential prompts without approval.
Relying on default model settings when output size or quality matters.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to use inference.sh CLI commands for Gemini image models.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples require the infsh CLI and login.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents image editing with input image URLs.

faq.question: Does it make network requests?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI communicates with inference.sh and model services, and search grounding can call external search.

faq.question: Is the quick install command safe?
faq.answer: The report flags the remote installer pattern. Inspect scripts and verify checksums before execution.
